claim_assertions.claim_1: Berkshire FY2025 average insurance float exceeded its FY2024 average insurance float.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The current-year unrealized equity gain exceeds the total pretax investment gain.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Parent-attributable earnings are the starting net earnings of the consolidated operating-cash bridge.

definitions.parent_earnings_bridge: After-tax parent scope for three years. Parent income is the sum of the disclosed after-tax parent earnings components. Operating earnings remove signed investment gains and signed equity-method impairments from that sum. Residual is the component sum less independently reported parent income.
definitions.consolidated_cash_bridge: Consolidated scope for three years. Parent income retains the independently reported parent amount, rather than the component sum in parent_earnings_bridge. Add all signed statement adjustments to consolidated net earnings. Noncontrolling income is consolidated less reported parent income. residual_usd_million is reconstructed operating cash flow less independently reported operating cash flow.
definitions.investment_gain_bridge: Pretax scope for three years. Net fixed gains combine realized gains and losses. Compare component total with the signed cash-flow removal and report unrealized equity gain divided by net pretax investment gain. cash_removal_residual_usd_million is net pretax investment gain components plus the signed cash-flow statement adjustment for investment gains.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
